check_gene_exp(species, gene, threshold=None)

Function to check gene expression levels for a given species and genes

Parameters:

  • species (-) – The species labels (“Hs” etc. Not “Human”)

  • gene (-) – The gene name to check gene expression levels for.

  • threshold (-) – If provided, a horizontal line at y=threshold

  • None. (will be added to the plot. Defaults to)

Examples

>>> data.gene_exp_check()
plot_read()

  • Simplified version of the expression matrix

Examples

>>> data.plot_read()
